title: Love the one you're with - JEAN-JACQUES MILTEAU, MICHAEL ROBINSON

lines.l: I was with the doubt, and if you can't be with the one you love, honey, love the one you with, love the one you with, get to love the one you with, love the one you with.
Don't be angry, don't be sad
Don't sit crying about the good times you had
Cause there's a girl right next to you
And she's just waiting for something to do
Cause there's a rose in a fisted glove
And the eagle flies with the dust
And if you can't be the one you love
Honey, love the one you win
Love the one you win
You gotta love the one you win
Love the one you win
Turn your heartache right into joy
She's a girl and you're a boy
Get it together, make it nice
You ain't gonna need any more advice
Cause there's a rose in a fisted glove
And the eagle flies with the dove
And if you can't be with the one you love
It brings a tear flow in the mind
When I begin to realize
